FUJITSU/MBM27128.note: Figure 3, the Quick Pro flow chart on page 4-20, specifies TPW = 1 ms +/- 50 us with VCC = 6V +/- 0.25V, VPP = 21V +/- 0.5V and an X = 20 pulse ceiling. Page 4-19's conventional procedure specifies a 50 ms pulse and is the wrong reading here: the firmware consumes this field as the initial pulse width of a verify-per-pulse loop capped at 25 pulses with overprogram_factor = 0 on protocols 0x07 and 0x08, which is the fast Quick Pro algorithm's shape and not the conventional single-shot one. Note also that the corrected value still yields an incomplete Quick Pro, because the firmware never emits the datasheet's tOPW over-program pulse. This entry's electrical.vdd_mv field also comes from that same Figure 3 table's VCC = 6V +/- 0.25V figure.

FUJITSU/MBM27C1000.note: AC CHARACTERISTICS (Single Byte Programming), p.4-68: tPW 0.475/0.50/0.525 ms

FUJITSU/MBM27C1001.note: Page 9-90's AC CHARACTERISTICS table: tPW 0.475/0.50/0.525 ms, N 1 to 25, tOPW 1.4/1.5/39.4 ms, measured at VCC1 6V +/- 0.25V and VPP2 12.5V +/- 0.3V. All three of this entry's fields -- programming.pulse_duration_us, electrical.vpp_mv and electrical.vdd_mv -- come from that same table.
